lead.headline: Pickens hurts a shoulder; Love and Golden cleared
lead.deck: Pickens's call has to be made on Saturday — nobody on this bench plays Monday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. George Pickens was limited Thursday with a shoulder, his first appearance on Dallas's report this season (The Big Lead, SI 22 Oct), and Dallas play Monday night — after every bench player here has kicked off. If Saturday's report lists him doubtful or out, Xavier Worthy goes into the flex before Sunday 18:20. Rashee Rice missed practice again. Better: Jordan Love was full in pads, LaFleur has 'no concern' about Matthew Golden (Yahoo 22 Oct), and Josh Jacobs practised in pads as Green Bay ramp him up. ESPN has it 49%, 122.8 to Furia Regia's 123.9.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to fire today — Pickens waits for Saturday, Jacobs for Sunday morning
doFirst.deck: Worthy is the fallback for both Golden and Pickens; Jacobs over Gordon only on a clear status by Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: No claims: priority never resets. Pickens (shoulder, Monday night): if Saturday's Cowboys report lists him doubtful or out, swap Worthy into the flex before Sun 18:20 — the full card is in the brief. Hold the Jets D/ST and Gay.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Thursday afternoon — Pickens is decided on Saturday's report, Golden at Sunday's inactives.

cards.headline: If Golden is inactive, Worthy takes his WR slot
cards.reason: Limited Wednesday and Thursday with a shoulder; LaFleur has no concern and Love is full. Worthy plays at 18:20, after Green Bay's inactives, so the swap stays open.

roster.deck: 0.9 below the projection lineup on a coin flip (Jacobs over Gordon); Golden and Pickens are conditional.

wire.headline: Nothing to claim — Mayer is next week's tight end
wire.deck: Priority never resets; Rice is the weakest receiver but on the exposure list, and every riser fills someone else's vacancy.
